what: Edison International owns Southern California Edison, which delivers electricity to about 15 million people across central, coastal and southern California. It delivers power but generates relatively little of it.
customers: Households, businesses and industry across a 50,000 square mile service area in southern California.
moat: A delivery monopoly across a large and wealthy service territory, with rates set by California regulators.
rivals: Los Angeles Department of Water and Power
risks: Wildfire liability is the dominant risk and California law holds utilities liable even without negligence
The January 2025 Eaton fire has produced very large claims against it
Debt of about $42 billion against almost no cash
Analyst targets imply the shares are already fully valued
opportunities: The California wildfire fund provides a buffer against catastrophic claims
Electrification of cars and heating in California raises long-term demand
watch: Eaton fire claims and recovery from the wildfire fund, and undergrounding progress.
